- `ARCEUS_OPENCODE_MODEL`

- model default: `"gpt-5.1-chat"`

```text
Creating OpenCode session (azure-cognitive-services/gpt-5.1-chat)
```

So the important clarification is:

- that log line is **not showing your Azure endpoint**
- it is showing the **OpenCode provider/model selection**
- and right now that selection is coming from **fallback defaults**, not from `.env`

If your friend was not seeing this, they likely had these set:

```env
ARCEUS_OPENCODE_PROVIDER=azure
ARCEUS_OPENCODE_MODEL=gpt-4.1
```

That also matches the repo docs in [ARCHITECTURE.md](/Users/divyansh/Arceus/doc/ARCHITECTURE.md:576).

If you want, I can add those two vars to your root `.env` right now and restart the server so Arceus uses the same provider/model path as your friend.
